reply_text:
I haven't set up the Monday 08:00 digest, and nothing is scheduled. My first reply here was wrong: I do have a job scheduler. My second reply said I would check before setting anything up, and that's still the state. I have not verified that a scheduled run can read both channels and post into #coastal-team.

Two things to decide before I create it:

1. Scope. The digest would cover #coastal-team and #coastal-random. Anything from those channels would be visible to the whole Coastal team, so it can't carry finance figures (rates, prices, discounts, contract values, payment terms) unless you get approval from Anselm Grieve or June Osei-Lark. Operational items like seat counts, renewal dates, tickets and meeting times are fine.
2. Who sets it up. If you want it live, tell me to create it and I'll test one run first. If the scheduled run can't post reliably, I'll say so rather than assume it works.
